Topic: Introduction to Holomorphic Dynamics: Iterating Complex Functions

Target audience: Undergraduate Mathematics Students

Section: section_1 — Prerequisites & The Complex Plane

Lecture lines:
Complex numbers are points in the plane.
Holomorphic functions define geometric mappings.
Consider the simple map f(z) equals z squared.

Planned animations:
Create complex plane with light gray #D3D3D3 grid lines.
Label imaginary axis #FF4500 and real axis #00CED1.
Plot a sample complex number z = a + bi #FFFFFF.

Section: section_2 — The Concept of Iteration

Lecture lines:
Iteration means repeatedly applying the same function.
Orbits trace the path of a starting point.
Simple rules create complex, dynamic sequences.

Planned animations:
Display z_0 = 0 at the origin #FFFFFF.
Animate mapping f(z) = z^2 + c with a #FFA500 point.
Trace path of points z_0, z_1, z_2... #00FF00.

Section: section_3 — Fixed Points and Stability

Lecture lines:
Fixed points satisfy the equation f(z) equals z.
Derivatives determine the stability of these points.
Attractors pull nearby points into their orbit.

Planned animations:
Mark a stable fixed point with a blue #1E90FF circle.
Show orbit converging to fixed point #00FF00.
Highlight unstable fixed point with a red #FF0000 X mark.

Section: section_4 — The Julia Set: The Boundary of Chaos

Lecture lines:
The Julia set is a chaotic boundary.
Iterates of points diverge at this edge.
Stability defines the surrounding Fatou set.

Planned animations:
Render grid of initial c values in color #FFFFFF.
Fill points that escape to infinity in dark blue #00008B.
Outline the Julia set boundary in bright yellow #FFFF00.

Section: section_5 — Application: The Mandelbrot Set

Lecture lines:
The Mandelbrot set maps all possible Julia sets.
The parameter c controls the dynamical system.
Small changes in c drastically alter behavior.

Planned animations:
Start with the complex plane c-space #000000.
Iterate z_0=0 for each c; color escape time #FF8C00.
Display the final Mandelbrot set shape in black #000000.

        z0_dot = Dot(color="#FFFFFF")
        self.place_at_grid(z0_dot, 'C3')
        z0_label = MathTex("z_0 = 0").next_to(z0_dot, UP)
        self.play(Create(z0_dot), Write(z0_label))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#FFA500"))
        
        # Iteration path

        z = 0
        points = [z]
        for _ in range(5):
            z = z**2 + c
            points.append(z)
            
        dots = VGroup()
        for p in points:

            dots.add(dot)

        self.wait(2)

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom

            for j, col in enumerate(cols):

                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])

        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]

        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2

        mobject.move_to(center)

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        self.wait(1)

        m_shape = VMobject(color=WHITE)
        m_shape.set_points_smoothly([self.grid['B3'], self.grid['B4'], self.grid['D5'], self.grid['E3'], self.grid['D2'], self.grid['B3']])
        m_shape.set_fill(WHITE, opacity=0.5)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(m_shape), self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(GREEN))
        self.wait(2)
